intent_snapshot.goal: Implement Slice S5 of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes): the lane-steward role is routable with its packaged mirror, an integrated clean Lane receives a release handoff, and the batch records the Lane released once its path is gone.

acceptance.assertion: Per Roles and contracts of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes) (sources: user decisions D3, D4, D9, D10): lane-steward is an Internal Role with a prompt under runtime/prompts and a byte-identical packaged mirror, routed by the loop contract; the prompt states the goal and deliverable (supply a Lane on the named branch at the named base, prepare it by the project's own instructions, start one allowlisted Executor Host there with an explicit imm-run entry, return the path, release a clean integrated Lane) and reports that it cannot supply a Lane rather than improvising; the Executor Host allowlist is the constant claude-code and pi. Positive: the role resolves and its mirror matches. Negative: the prompt, the runtime and the imm-run contract contain no workspace-tool name, command, path or agent kind and assume no language or package manager; a provision handoff offers only allowlisted hosts. Bound: no new public skill is added. Agreed seams: tests/role-prompt-bridge.test.ts, tests/role-prompt-bundled-layout.test.ts, tests/loop-execution-routing.test.ts, tests/dist-docs-sync-contract.test.ts.

Per Interfaces (release handoff) and State transitions of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes) (source: user decision D8; ADR 0013 consequence on surviving terminal evidence): after a child is integrated, its Lane is clean and its .imm/audit/<task_id>/ pair is reachable from the batch branch, the report carries a release handoff for lane-steward, and a later tick that observes the Lane path gone records the child released. Positive: release is emitted and removal is observed as released. Negative: no release handoff for a parked, failed, dirty or unintegrated Lane, and none when the audit pair is not reachable from the batch branch; the runtime itself removes no worktree and deletes no branch. Bound: a Lane that is still present stays integrated and the batch still completes. Agreed seam: tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts.

advisory_findings.summary: The in-flight lane report's next-step text keys on any lane-steward handoff. A release handoff now also selects 'Provide a Lane for each provision handoff', even when only executor and release handoffs exist, so the guidance is misleading. Handoff content and state are correct. Non-blocking: narrow the check to action === 'provision'.

evidence.trigger: Lane mode with one child enrolled (executor handoff) and another integrated, clean and audit-reachable (release handoff), with no startable child, so no provision handoff is emitted
